farm_name: Depot Street Meats & Dairy at L.D. Farms

feeding_claim.verbatim: Our pasture raised Belted Galloway Cattle are 100% Grass Fed and Grass Finished.

farmers_markets: Friday market at 181 Front Street, next to the Better Living Center (10am to 1pm)
Saturday market at 129 Main Street, near the Courthouse (10am to 1pm)
notes: Scout 2026-11-25: read the depotstreetmeats.com homepage, contact, Depot Street Meats, Belted Galloway beef, pastured lamb, heritage poultry and eggs, Depot Street Dairy (general-8), farm store and price list pages. Beef and lamb are grass fed and grass finished on the farm; chickens are pastured from 5 weeks and supplemented with local grains fermented in goat milk. Licensed Maine raw milk dairy (Guernsey goats and a Normande cow); butter and kefir come from the dairy page's meta description. Raw milk sales are legal only in some states. Farm store hours Mon to Thu 12 to 6, Fri 2 to 6, Sat 1 to 6. Verifier: the two market addresses name no town (likely Farmington, Franklin County, not confirmed on the site); the farm store page mentions a partnership with Western Maine Market for customers not nearby, not checked; price list page URL says 2023 while the menu says 2025. Lamb meat shares are limited; no quarter or half beef offered, so bulk_shares is false.
